rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Two piles of cards are offered:
rules.home.text: offers activities to do at home.
rules.draw: Pick a pile, draw a card, and let chance do its thing.
rules.reveal: Once the card is revealed, two choices are offered:
rules.return: Return the card to the pile so it may reappear later.
rules.ban: Ban the card to remove it permanently. You can still restore it from the "Bans" menu.
rules.swipe: Besides the buttons, you can swipe the revealed card left to ban it or right to return it to the pile. Sound familiar…

admin.cards.tools.title: Deck maintenance
admin.cards.tools.hint: Keep the database aligned with the JSON files versioned on the server. Export the current deck to back it up before any operation.
admin.deckSync.title: Sync the deck
admin.deckSync.intro: Load the contents of the cards.{{locale}}.json file shipped with the server and apply them to the database.
admin.deckSync.mode.mirror.hint: The database exactly mirrors the file. Cards present in the database but missing from the file are deleted (along with their banned copies).
admin.deckSync.mode.upsert.hint: Adds new cards and updates existing ones. Cards missing from the file are kept as-is.
admin.deckSync.backupHint: It is recommended to export a backup before applying a full mirror sync.
admin.deckSync.summary.title: Summary
admin.deckImport.title: Import a backup
admin.deckImport.intro: Load a JSON file in the deck format to replace or top up the database.
